branches.en: The leaving branch: walking out of the office.
branches.cn: 出发分支：走出办公室。

branches.en: The trip branch: a fortnight on an island.
branches.cn: 旅行分支：在岛上待两周。

branches.en: The court branch: the bench is empty in September.
branches.cn: 法院分支：九月里法官席空着。

branches.en: The old branch: the chair left without a holder.
branches.cn: 旧分支：席位无人担任。

branches.en: The blend: holiday and journey share one noun today.
branches.cn: 融合分支：今天假期与旅程共用一个名词。

intro.en: The Latin root of emptiness plus the noun ending of state: an emptied calendar.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「空」词根加表示状态的名词词尾：被腾空的日历。

latinIntro.en: Vacare, to be free, gives vacatio; the ending -atio becomes English -ation as in creation and relation.
latinIntro.cn: vacare（自由无事）给出 vacatio；词尾 -atio 在英语中变为 -ation，如 creation、relation。

items.example: Vacation is a time left free.
Creation and relation share the ending.
items.exampleCN: creation 与 relation 共用这一词尾。

items.example: Holiday keeps day at the end.

definition_zh: 含糊的；模糊的；不明确的；隐约的
definition_en: not expressed or understood clearly, or seen only in an unclear outline
core_image: 隔着一层蒙雾的玻璃看外面走过来的人
scene: 雾很重，街对面有人在挥手，轮廓却像是被水泡开了一样，看不清到底是谁。His answer was so vague that nobody knew the date.
sceneCN: 这里 vague 是「含糊的、不明确的」（第 1 个义项：说法不清楚）；句意为他的回答太含糊，谁也没弄明白日期。隔着蒙雾看人的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 加 -ly 构成副词，义为「模糊地；含糊地」
加 -ness 构成名词，义为「含糊；模糊」
同根名词，义为「奇想；无常的变化」
同根动词，义为「离题；漫游」

senses.title: Not clearly stated
senses.definition: expressed in words that leave the meaning unclear
senses.definitionCN: 用让人无法确定含义的话表达
senses.example: The letter was vague about the exact time.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信对具体时间说得很含糊。
senses.why: A word that means wandering cannot pin anything down, so speech built on it leaves the listener without a fixed point.
senses.whyCN: 一个意为「游走」的词抓不住任何东西，因此由它构成的言语让听的人找不到落点。

senses.title: Without a clear shape
senses.definition: seen or remembered without clear outlines
senses.definitionCN: 看到或记得的东西轮廓不清
senses.example: A vague shape moved behind the curtain.
senses.exampleCN: 窗帘后面有个模糊的影子在动。
senses.why: An outline that will not settle is a wandering line, which is exactly what the Latin adjective describes.
senses.whyCN: 定不下来的轮廓就是一条游走的线，这正是那个拉丁形容词所描述的。

senses.title: An idea not fully formed
senses.definition: of a thought or feeling that is not yet worked out
senses.definitionCN: 形容想法或感觉尚未成形
senses.example: I had only a vague idea of what the job involved.
senses.exampleCN: 我对这份工作具体干什么只有个模糊的概念。
senses.why: Thoughts take shape gradually, and while the shape wanders it can only be described as unclear.
senses.whyCN: 想法是慢慢成形的，形状还在游走时，就只能说它不明确。

senses.title: Uncertain or absent-minded
senses.definition: of a person, not paying full attention or not sure of things
senses.definitionCN: 形容人不专注或对事情没把握
senses.example: She looked vaguely at the papers and said nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 她心不在焉地看了看那些文件，什么也没说。
senses.why: A mind that wanders off has no fixed object of attention, so the same adjective describes the person.
senses.whyCN: 心思走神的人没有固定的注意对象，于是同一个形容词也用来说人。

intro.en: A Latin adjective of wandering borrowed through French, with no live prefix or suffix inside it.
intro.cn: 一个意为「漫游」的拉丁形容词经法语借入，里面已没有仍在起作用的前后缀。

items.en: Vagus meant wandering, unsettled, or uncertain, and vagari meant to roam about.
items.cn: vagus 意为「漫游的、不定的、含糊的」，vagari 意为「四处游荡」。

items.en: The word entered French as vague, where the hard g softened before the final vowel.
items.cn: 这个词以 vague 的形式进入法语，尾元音前的 g 也随之软化。

items.en: English adopts the word in the sixteenth century for unclear statements.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪采用这个词，指不清楚的说法。

items.en: The sense extends to outlines and memories that cannot be fixed.
items.cn: 词义扩展到无法定形的轮廓与记忆上。

items.en: Vaguely and vagueness become the common adverb and noun of the family.
items.cn: vaguely 与 vagueness 成为这一词族常用的副词与名词。

note.en: The look-alike group is the small vag- family, and the near-meaning group pairs unclear with plain and certain.
note.cn: 形近组是小小的 vag- 词族，近义组把模糊与清楚、确定相对照。

entries.definition: the current fashion, only the spelling looks close, the root is different
entries.definitionCN: 风尚；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: open to more than one meaning
blurred and hard to make out

normalIntro.en: Hold on to wandering: a line that wanders has no clear edge, and neither does a vague answer.
normalIntro.cn: 抓住「游走」这个意思：游走的线没有清楚的边，含糊的回答也一样。

normal.en: Vague about something is the standard frame for being unclear.
normal.cn: vague about something 是表示「说不清」的标准框架。

normal.en: The adverb vaguely often means slightly, as in vaguely familiar.
normal.cn: 副词 vaguely 常表示「略微」，如 vaguely familiar。

normal.en: Vagueness is criticised in academic writing, where precision is expected.
normal.cn: 学术写作要求精确，所以常批评 vagueness。

normal.en: The comparative is vaguer, keeping the e in spelling.
normal.cn: 比较级是 vaguer，拼写里保留了 e。

normal.en: The same root appears in vagary, a wandering notion.
normal.cn: 同一词根见于 vagary，指游移不定的念头。

abstract.en: Picture a person waving across a street through heavy fog.
abstract.cn: 想象雾中街对面一个人在挥手。

abstract.en: Hear an instruction that says soon, without any hour.
abstract.cn: 听一句只说要「很快」却没有钟点的指示。

abstract.en: Try to recall a face from a dream and lose the eyes.
abstract.cn: 试着回忆梦里的一张脸，眼睛却总是想不起来。

examples.en: He was vague about where he had been that night.
examples.cn: 他对那晚去了哪里说得含含糊糊。

examples.en: I have only a vague memory of the house.
examples.cn: 我对那栋房子只有模糊的记忆。

examples.en: She waved vaguely toward the door and left.
examples.cn: 她心不在焉地朝门口挥了挥手就走了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「微格」——答案只剩微博那么一格，自然含含糊糊。

root: 拉丁语 vagus（漫游的、不定的）与 vagari（游荡），经法语 vague 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: Wandering yields lines that will not settle, and those lines give unclear speech, blurred outlines, unfinished ideas, and a mind that drifts.
sensesIntro.cn: 「漫游」带来定不下来的线条，而这些线条给出含糊的言语、模糊的轮廓、未完形的想法与飘走的注意力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure waving through a misted window.
core.cn: 核心意象：隔着蒙雾的玻璃，一个人影在挥手。

branches.en: The words branch: an answer that will not commit.
branches.cn: 言辞分支：不肯明确的回答。

branches.en: The shape branch: a silhouette without an outline.
branches.cn: 轮廓分支：没有清晰边界的身影。

branches.en: The idea branch: a notion still without edges.
branches.cn: 念头分支：还没有边界的想法。

branches.en: The person branch: eyes that are not quite here.
branches.cn: 人身分支：眼神并不完全在此处。

branches.en: The clarity branch: what is missing is the plain outline of things.
branches.cn: 清晰分支：缺的正是事物清楚的样子。

intro.en: A borrowed adjective with no live prefix; its only everyday additions are -ly and -ness.
intro.cn: 一个借入的形容词，没有仍起作用的前缀；日常只在其后加 -ly 与 -ness。

latinIntro.en: Latin vagus, wandering, plus the verb vagari, to roam, share one root with no surviving prefix.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vagus（漫游的）与动词 vagari（游荡）共用一个词根，没有留存下来的前缀。

items.exampleCN: 游走的线条总定不下来。

items.example: French gave the word its softer ending.
items.exampleCN: 法语给了这个词更柔和的词尾。
vaguely 描述不明确的方式。
vagueness 就是这一性质本身。

items.example: Divagate adds the idea of straying away.
A blur is what vague things look like.
items.exampleCN: 模糊之物看起来就是一团晕影。

definition_zh: 山谷；河谷；流域；凹处
definition_en: a low stretch of land between hills, often with a river running through it
core_image: 两侧山坡倾斜下来，中间一条河慢慢流过
scene: 清晨的雾还没散，两侧山脊像两道墙，河在底部弯了一下，把村子圈在里面。The village sits in a narrow valley below the pass.
sceneCN: 这里 valley 是「山谷」（第 1 个义项：山间的低地）；句意为村子坐落在山口下方一道狭窄的山谷里。两侧山坡夹着一条河的画面，正是这个词的核心。

collocations.phrase: valley of the shadow of death

derivatives.zh: 同源名词，义为「谷；（诗）山谷」
拉丁语原词，义为「山谷」
同义本土词，义为「山谷」
同义小词，义为「小山谷」

senses.title: Low land between hills
senses.definition: a long low area of land lying between hills or mountains
senses.definitionCN: 夹在山丘或高山之间的一片狭长低地
senses.example: A small stream runs along the bottom of the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 一条小溪沿着谷底流过。
senses.why: Latin vallis named the fold itself, and the landform is the plainest thing the word can point at.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 vallis 指的就是这道褶皱，而地形正是这个词最初所指的东西。

senses.title: The land drained by a river
senses.definition: the area of land through which a river runs and which it drains
senses.definitionCN: 一条河流经并汇集来水的整片土地
senses.example: The farms in the valley all depend on that one river.
senses.exampleCN: 河谷里的农场都靠这一条河。
senses.why: Water collects in the lowest line of the fold, so the river and the land it feeds take the same name.
senses.whyCN: 水总是汇聚到褶皱最低的那一线，于是河流与它养活的土地共用了这个名字。

senses.title: A dip or hollow in a surface
senses.definition: a low part in a line on a graph or in a surface
senses.definitionCN: 图表曲线或表面上的低洼部分
senses.example: Sales fell into a valley between two peaks.
senses.exampleCN: 销量在两个高峰之间落进了谷底。
senses.why: Any line that drops and rises again traces the same v shape, so the landform becomes a metaphor for a dip.
senses.whyCN: 任何先下后上的曲线都画出同一个 v 形，地形于是被借来比喻凹陷。

senses.title: A place that seems low or humble
senses.definition: in figurative use, a low point of fortune or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 引申指境遇或情绪的低点
senses.example: The years after the factory closed were a valley for the town.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂关闭后的那些年是这个镇子的低谷。
senses.why: A low stretch between two highs of life is felt as a valley, and the picture of the landscape carries the feeling.
senses.whyCN: 人生两个高点之间那段低处被感受为谷，正是地形画面承载了这种情绪。

intro.en: A Latin word for a fold in the land, carried through French with the native twin dale beside it.
intro.cn: 一个指「大地褶皱」的拉丁词，经法语进入英语，旁边还站着本土兄弟词 dale。

items.en: Vallis or valles named a valley in classical Latin.
items.cn: 古典拉丁语用 vallis 或 valles 指山谷。

items.en: French made valee from the Latin stem, keeping the same shape of land.
items.cn: 法语从拉丁词干造出 valee，指的还是同样的地形。

items.en: Middle English borrows valee and spells it valley by the end of the period.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 valee，到该时期末拼作 valley。

items.en: The native word dale, from Old English dæl, already named the same thing.
items.cn: 本土词 dale 出自古英语 dæl，原本就指同一地形。

items.en: The sense widens to river basins, dips in graphs, and low points of fortune.
items.cn: 词义扩展到河流盆地、图表凹陷与境遇的低点。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the Latin and native words for the same landform, and the near-meaning group sets the low ground against its opposites.
note.cn: 形近组收集同指这一地形的拉丁词与本土词，近义组把低地与它的反面放在一起。

entries.definition: a valley, now chiefly poetic or in place names
entries.definitionCN: 山谷；现多用于诗歌或地名

entries.definition: the Latin noun for a valley
a valley, chiefly in northern English place names
entries.definitionCN: 山谷；多用于英格兰北部地名

entries.definition: a deep valley with steep rock sides
a wide low area drained by a river
a long narrow high top of land

normalIntro.en: Picture the shape of the letter v: two sides dropping to a floor, which is what a valley is.
normalIntro.cn: 想象字母 v 的形状：两侧向下收到一个底部，山谷正是如此。

normal.en: The plural is valleys, y kept before the s.
normal.cn: 复数是 valleys，y 后直接加 s。

normal.en: Valley floor is the standard phrase for the flat bottom.
normal.cn: 谷底的标准说法是 valley floor。

normal.en: Silicon Valley is a place name that now names an industry.
normal.cn: Silicon Valley 本是地名，现在也指一个产业。

normal.en: The old poetic form vale survives in place names.
normal.cn: 古老的诗歌形式 vale 仍留在地名中。

normal.en: Dale and dell are the native English cousins of valley.
normal.cn: dale 与 dell 是 valley 的英语本土兄弟词。

abstract.en: Picture mist sitting between two long ridges at dawn.
abstract.cn: 想象黎明时雾停在两道长山脊之间。

abstract.en: Follow a river bending once and enclosing a village.
abstract.cn: 顺着一条河打了个弯，把村子圈在里面。

abstract.en: See a sales chart dip into a u shape.
abstract.cn: 看销量曲线凹成一个 u 形。

examples.en: The road follows the valley for twenty kilometres.
examples.cn: 这条路沿着山谷延伸二十公里。

examples.en: Fog filled the valley floor before sunrise.
examples.cn: 日出前雾布满谷底。

examples.en: Many orchards in the valley were damaged by frost.
examples.cn: 山谷里的许多果园被霜冻毁了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「洼里」——地势往洼里陷下去的那一块，就是山谷。

root: 拉丁语 vallis（山谷），经古法语 valee 进入英语，拼作 valley

sensesIntro.en: A fold in the land gives the river that fills it, then any dip in a line or graph, and finally a low point of fortune.
sensesIntro.cn: 大地上的一道褶皱给出填满它的河流，再给出曲线或图表上的凹陷，最后给出境遇上的低谷。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hillsides sloping down to a river.
core.cn: 核心意象：两侧山坡斜下，中间一条河。

branches.en: The landform branch: the plainest shape of the word.
branches.cn: 地形分支：这个词最朴素的形状。

branches.en: The river branch: water gathers in the fold.
branches.cn: 河流分支：水往褶皱里汇。

branches.en: The graph branch: any line that dips.
branches.cn: 图表分支：任何向下凹陷的曲线。

branches.en: The fortune branch: lows of emotion and of money.
branches.cn: 境遇分支：情绪与银钱上的低谷。

branches.en: The place-name branch: a district known as the valley.
branches.cn: 地名分支：整个区域被称作山谷。

intro.en: A Latin word for a fold in the land, reshaped by French, with dale and dell as its native partners.
intro.cn: 一个指大地褶皱的拉丁词，经法语改写而成，本土对应词是 dale 与 dell。

latinIntro.en: Latin vallis, valley, became valee in French and valley in English; the shortened vale is kept for poetry and names.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vallis（山谷）在法语中成 valee，在英语中成 valley；缩短的 vale 留给诗歌与地名。

items.example: The root vall- means a hollow between hills.
items.exampleCN: 词根 vall- 指山间低处。

items.example: The ending marks a stretch of land.
Dale is the Germanic partner word.
items.exampleCN: dale 是日耳曼语的对应词。

items.example: A dell is small and wooded.
A river valley is cut by water.

definition_zh: 有价值的；宝贵的；贵重的；值钱的
definition_en: worth a great deal of money, or of great help and importance
core_image: 老木箱底层用绒布包着的一枚旧戒指
scene: 阁楼上翻出一只旧木箱，最底层用绒布包着一枚戒指，祖母的名字刻在里面。The ring is small but valuable.
sceneCN: 这里 valuable 是「贵重的、值钱的」（第 1 个义项：值很多钱）；句意为那枚戒指虽小却很贵重。绒布里的旧戒指，正是这个词的核心。

collocations.phrase: keep valuable things in a safe
collocations.zh: 把贵重物品放在保险箱里

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀的名词，义为「价值」
加否定前缀 in-，义为「无价的；极宝贵的」
同根名词，义为「估价；评价」
换成 -less，义为「毫无价值的」

senses.title: Worth a lot of money
senses.definition: worth a large amount of money if sold
senses.definitionCN: 如果卖掉能值很多钱
senses.example: The necklace is valuable and should be kept in a safe.
senses.exampleCN: 这条项链很贵，应该放进保险箱。
senses.why: The suffix -able adds can be to the noun for worth, so the word first means able to be sold for a lot.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -able 给「价值」加上「可以」之义，于是这个词首先表示「能卖出大价钱的」。

senses.title: Of great help or importance
senses.definition: of great use or importance to someone
senses.definitionCN: 对某人很有用或很重要
senses.example: Her advice was valuable in the first weeks of the job.
senses.exampleCN: 刚入职的头几周，她的建议很宝贵。
senses.why: What can be counted as worth spreads from coins to help, since good advice is worth as much as money.
senses.whyCN: 能被算作「值」的东西从钱币扩展到帮助：好建议和钱一样值。

senses.title: Worth the time spent
senses.definition: of an experience, worth having for what it teaches
senses.definitionCN: 形容一段经历因教益而值得拥有
senses.example: Working in the shop was a valuable experience.
senses.exampleCN: 在店里干过那段活是很有价值的经历。
senses.why: Time is a cost like money, so an experience that repays the time is called valuable too.
senses.whyCN: 时间也像钱一样是成本，因此一段能抵回时间的经历也被叫作 valuable。

senses.title: Small costly things kept together
senses.definition: in the plural, personal items of great worth such as jewellery
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指珠宝等值钱的私人物品
senses.example: Put your valuables in the hotel safe.
senses.exampleCN: 把贵重物品放进酒店保险箱。
senses.why: The adjective is turned into a plural noun for the costly things themselves, the ones worth locking away.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转成复数名词，指那些值钱、值得锁起来的东西本身。

intro.en: The adjective of worth, built on the Latin stem that also gives value and valour.
intro.cn: 表示「值得」的形容词，建在与 value、valour 相同的拉丁词干上。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong and to be worth; the noun valor named worth and courage.
items.cn: valere 意为「强壮、值得」，名词 valor 指价值与勇气。

items.en: French formed value from the popular Latin noun valuta, a thing worth so much.
items.cn: 法语从通俗拉丁语名词 valuta（值若干的东西）造出 value。

items.en: English adds -able to value and gets valuable, able to be worth much.
items.cn: 英语在 value 后加 -able 得到 valuable，意为「能值很多的」。

items.en: The plural valuables names costly personal things kept safe.
items.cn: 复数 valuables 指收存妥当的贵重私人物品。

items.en: The sense widens to advice, information, and experiences that are worth having.
items.cn: 词义扩展到值得拥有的建议、信息与经历。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the worth family, and the near-meaning group sets the costly apart from the worthless and the priceless.
note.cn: 形近组收集表示「值」的词族，近义组把贵重与毫无价值、无价之物放在一起。

entries.definition: so precious that no price can be set, not worthless
entries.definitionCN: 无价的；极宝贵的（并非「没价值」）

entries.definition: of great worth and not to be lost
bought or kept at a high price

normalIntro.en: Turn value into an adjective with -able: it can be valued because it is worth something.
normalIntro.cn: 把 value 加 -able 变成形容词：因为值东西，所以可以被估出价。

normal.en: Valuables in the plural means jewellery and watches, not abstract worth.
normal.cn: 复数 valuables 指珠宝腕表，不是抽象价值。

normal.en: Invaluable is not the opposite of valuable; it means priceless.
normal.cn: invaluable 并非 valuable 的反义，而是「无价的」。

normal.en: Valuable to somebody is the usual frame for usefulness.
normal.cn: valuable to somebody 是表示「对某人有用」的常见框架。

normal.en: The comparative is more valuable, not valuabler.
normal.cn: 比较级用 more valuable，不用 valuabler。

normal.en: Value is the noun and verb behind it.
normal.cn: 背后的名词与动词是 value。

abstract.en: Picture a ring in cloth, engraved with a grandmother's name.
abstract.cn: 想象绒布里一枚刻着祖母名字的戒指。

abstract.en: Hear advice at a first job that saves a month of mistakes.
abstract.cn: 听入职时的一句建议，省下一个月弯路。

abstract.en: See a list taped to a hotel door asking you to use the safe.
abstract.cn: 看酒店门上那张请你使用保险箱的纸条。

examples.en: The painting turned out to be far more valuable than expected.
examples.cn: 这幅画结果比预想的贵重得多。

examples.en: Your comments were valuable, and the report is clearer now.
examples.cn: 你的意见很有价值，报告现在清楚多了。

examples.en: Guests are asked to leave valuables at the front desk.
examples.cn: 客人被要求把贵重物品寄存在前台。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「歪流包」——宝物流到歪处也得包起来收好。

root: 拉丁语 valere（值得、强壮）→ 名词 value，加形容词后缀 -able 构成 valuable

sensesIntro.en: The core of worth spreads from price to help, to time well spent, and to precious things named in the plural.
sensesIntro.cn: 「值得」这个核心从价格扩展到帮助，再扩展到值得花的时间，最后成为复数形式所指的贵重物品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old ring wrapped in cloth at the bottom of a box.
core.cn: 核心意象：木箱底部绒布包着的一枚旧戒指。

branches.en: The price branch: it would sell high.
branches.cn: 价格分支：能卖个好价。

branches.en: The help branch: it makes things better.
branches.cn: 帮助分支：它让事情变好。

branches.en: The experience branch: time that returns more than it cost.
branches.cn: 经历分支：花出去的时间回本更多。

branches.en: The noun branch: the costly objects themselves.
branches.cn: 名词分支：贵重物品本身。

branches.en: The judgement branch: worth is counted in money or in benefit.
branches.cn: 评判分支：价值或以钱计，或以益计。

intro.en: Worth turned into an adjective with -able, with a negative and a privative partner close by.
intro.cn: 把「值得」用 -able 变成形容词，旁边还有否定与「无」两个伙伴。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere, to be worth, gives value; adding -able gives the adjective, adding in- gives invaluable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 valere（值得）给出 value；加 -able 成形容词，加 in- 成 invaluable。

items.example: Value is what the adjective measures.
items.exampleCN: value 是这个形容词衡量的东西。

items.example: The root val- sits behind the family.
items.exampleCN: 词根 val- 支撑整个词族。

items.example: Worth is the plain English twin.
items.exampleCN: worth 是朴素的英语孪生词。

definition_zh: 价值；价格；重要性；重视；估量
definition_en: the worth of something in money or in importance, or to think highly of it
core_image: 旧货商把一只旧表端在手里，翻看背面刻字
scene: 旧货铺里，老板把一只黄铜表翻过来，看背面的刻字和磨损，然后才报出一个数。The dealer set a value of two hundred on the watch.
sceneCN: 这里 value 是「价值、估价」（第 1 个义项：值多少）；句意为旧货商给那只表估了两百。端表翻看的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 加 -able 构成形容词，义为「有价值的」
加 in- 与 -able 构成，义为「无价的」
加 -ation 构成名词，义为「估价」
加 -less 构成，义为「毫无价值的」

senses.title: Worth in money
senses.definition: the amount of money something is worth or would sell for
senses.definitionCN: 某物值多少钱或能卖多少钱
senses.example: The value of the house has doubled in ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子十年间价值翻了一倍。
senses.why: Latin valere meant to be worth, and the noun first names what a thing can be exchanged for.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 valere 意为「值得」，这个名词最初指一件东西能换来的那个数目。

senses.title: Worth in importance
senses.definition: the importance or usefulness of something that is not for sale
senses.definitionCN: 某些非卖品的重要性或用处
senses.example: The value of the trip lay in the people she met.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行的价值在于她遇见的人。
senses.why: If worth can be counted, it need not be counted in coins, so the word moves to things that are priceless.
senses.whyCN: 既然「值」可以计量，就不必只以钱币计量，于是词义挪到了无价之物上。

senses.title: To think highly of something
senses.definition: to consider something important and worth keeping
senses.definitionCN: 认为某物重要、值得保留
senses.example: He values his friends more than his salary.
senses.exampleCN: 他看重朋友胜过薪水。
senses.why: To see worth in something is to prize it, so the noun becomes a verb of holding dear.
senses.whyCN: 看出一件事的价值就是看重它，于是名词转成了表示珍惜的动词。

senses.title: To estimate the worth of something
senses.definition: to work out how much money something is worth
senses.definitionCN: 算定某物值多少钱
senses.example: The house was valued at a lower figure last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子去年的估价更低。
senses.why: The other verb use keeps the money sense: to value is to put a figure on what something is worth.
senses.whyCN: 动词的另一用法保留了钱款义：value 就是给某物定一个价。

senses.title: A belief about what matters
senses.definition: in the plural, the beliefs a person or group holds about right and wrong
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指个人或群体对是非的观念
senses.example: The school says it teaches traditional values.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校称它教授传统观念。
senses.why: The things a group prizes are its values, so the plural names beliefs rather than prices.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体所看重的东西就是它的 values，因此复数指观念而不是价格。

intro.en: The Latin root of worth, borrowed through French as a noun and then turned into a verb in English.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「值得」的词根，经法语借入作名词，后在英语中转为动词。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong or to be worth, and valor named worth and courage.
items.cn: valere 意为「强壮、值得」，valor 指价值与勇气。

items.en: The feminine participle valuta meant a thing worth so much.
items.cn: 阴性分词 valuta 意为「值若干的东西」。

items.en: French valoir and the noun value carried the sense of worth into use.
items.cn: 法语 valoir 与名词 value 把「值」这一意义带入使用。

items.en: English borrows value as a noun of price and worth.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 value，作价格与价值的名词。

items.en: The verb senses of prizing and pricing grow, and the plural values names beliefs.
items.cn: 表示珍视与估价的动词义发展起来，复数 values 指观念。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the worth family, and the near-meaning group sets worth against price and cost.
note.cn: 形近组收集表示「值」的词族，近义组把价值与价格、成本放在一起。

entries.definition: what is given up to get something

normalIntro.en: One noun covers both the price on a tag and the worth a person refuses to sell.
normalIntro.cn: 一个名词同时覆盖标签上的价格与人情里不肯出售的价值。

normal.en: Value for money is the standard phrase in shopping and reviews.
normal.cn: value for money 是购物与评测中的标准说法。

normal.en: Values in the plural means beliefs, not prices.
normal.cn: 复数 values 指观念，不是价格。

normal.en: The verb takes both frames: value a friend, value a house.
normal.cn: 这个动词两种框架都用：value a friend 与 value a house。

normal.en: Valuable and invaluable look like opposites but are not.
normal.cn: valuable 与 invaluable 看着像反义，其实不是。

normal.en: Valuation is the formal word from the same stem.
normal.cn: valuation 是同词干上的正式名词。

abstract.en: Picture a dealer turning a brass watch to read the engraving.
abstract.cn: 想象旧货商翻过黄铜表看刻字。

abstract.en: See a friend keep a letter that has no price at all.
abstract.cn: 看朋友留着一封无从标价的信。

abstract.en: Hear a school claim it teaches old-fashioned values.
abstract.cn: 听一所学校说它教老式的观念。

examples.en: The value of the land rose sharply after the road was built.
examples.cn: 修路之后这块地的价值猛涨。

examples.en: She values honesty more than politeness.
examples.cn: 她看重诚实胜过礼貌。

examples.en: The painting was valued at ten thousand pounds.
examples.cn: 这幅画被估价一万英镑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「为留」——有价值的东西才值得为之留下来。

root: 拉丁语 valere（值得、强壮）的阴性分词 valuta（价值），经古法语 value 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: The core of worth gives money, then importance, then the two verbs of prizing and pricing, and finally the beliefs people hold.
sensesIntro.cn: 「值得」这个核心先给出钱款，再给出重要性，再给出珍视与估价两个动词，最后给出人们所持的观念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dealer turning a brass watch in his hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧货商手里翻看一只黄铜表。

branches.en: The price branch: a figure on a tag.
branches.cn: 价格分支：标签上的数字。

branches.en: The meaning branch: worth without a price.
branches.cn: 意义分支：无价的价值。

branches.en: The holding branch: friendship kept above salary.
branches.cn: 持有分支：友情重于薪水。

branches.en: The pricing branch: an expert puts a number on it.
branches.cn: 定价分支：专家给出一个数字。

branches.en: The belief branch: shared ideas of what matters.
branches.cn: 观念分支：共同认定的重要之事。

intro.en: A Latin root of worth carried into English through French, later hosting a crowd of suffixes.
intro.cn: 一个表示「值得」的拉丁词根经法语进入英语，后来又接上了一大串后缀。

latinIntro.en: Valere, to be worth, gives valuta; French shortens it to value, and English takes value as both noun and verb.
latinIntro.cn: valere（值得）给出 valuta；法语缩为 value，英语把 value 同时用作名词与动词。

items.example: The root covers worth and strength together.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根同时覆盖价值与强壮。

items.example: The ending shows a borrowed noun.
items.exampleCN: 这一词尾显示是借入名词。

items.example: Worth and value answer each other.
items.exampleCN: worth 与 value 彼此对应。

latinEntries.meaning: to be worth, to be strong

definition_zh: 货车；厢式车；面包车；（英）火车行李车厢
definition_en: a covered vehicle for carrying goods or people, smaller than a lorry and closed at the back
core_image: 一辆白色厢式车后门打开，里面堆着纸箱
scene: 楼下的面包车横在门口，后门敞开，两个工人开始往外搬成摞的纸箱。The delivery van blocked the narrow street.
sceneCN: 这里 van 是「厢式货车、面包车」（第 1 个义项：运货或载人的封闭车辆）；句意为那辆送货车堵住了狭窄的街道。后门敞开、堆满纸箱的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 古英语中的同形词，义为「簸箕；风选工具」
同源家族词，义为「大篷车；房车」
复合词，义为「运货司机」
复合词，义为「一车的量」

senses.title: A covered vehicle for goods
senses.definition: a road vehicle with a roof and closed sides, used for carrying goods
senses.definitionCN: 有顶、两侧封闭、用于运货的公路车辆
senses.example: They moved the whole flat in one van.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用一辆货车装下了整套公寓的东西。
senses.why: The clipped word keeps the covered body of the older caravan, and a covered body is what carries goods.
senses.whyCN: 这个截短词保留了 caravan 的带篷车身，而带篷的车身正是用来装货的。

senses.title: A vehicle for carrying people
senses.definition: a closed vehicle used to carry a small group of people
senses.definitionCN: 用于载少数人的封闭车辆
senses.example: A van takes the children to school each morning.
senses.exampleCN: 每天早上有一辆面包车送孩子们上学。
senses.why: The same closed box that holds boxes can hold people, so the vehicle needs only seats instead of crates.
senses.whyCN: 同一只装货的封闭箱子也能装人，于是车里的纸箱换成座位就成了面包车。

senses.title: A railway carriage for luggage or parcels
senses.definition: in British English, a separate railway carriage for luggage, mail, or goods
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中指单独的行李、邮件或货物车厢
senses.example: Leave your cases in the guard's van.
senses.exampleCN: 把箱子放在列车员的行李车厢里。
senses.why: Railways named their goods and luggage cars after the road wagon, so a van on rails carries the same load.
senses.whyCN: 铁路把运货与载行李的车厢按公路货车的名字命名，于是铁轨上的 van 也装着同样的东西。

senses.title: A short form of caravan
senses.definition: in British use, the short form of caravan, a vehicle towed for holidays
senses.definitionCN: 英式用法中为 caravan 的简称，指拖挂式假日房车
senses.example: They spent a wet week in a van by the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在海边的一辆房车里度过了一个阴雨周。
senses.why: Since van began as a clipping of caravan, the full word and the short one still overlap in British speech.
senses.whyCN: 既然 van 本来就是 caravan 的截短，全形与短形在英国口语里仍然交叠。

intro.en: A clipped form of caravan, which came to English from Persian by way of French and Latin.
intro.cn: caravan 的截短形式，而 caravan 是从波斯语经法语与拉丁语进入英语的。

items.en: Karwan named a company of merchants or pilgrims travelling together.
items.cn: karwan 指结队同行的商队或朝圣者。

items.en: Latin took the word as caravana, a group of travellers.
items.cn: 拉丁语取用为 caravana，指结队的旅人。

items.en: French caravane named both the travellers and the covered wagon they used.
items.cn: 法语 caravane 兼指旅队与他们所乘的带篷车。

items.en: English caravan comes to mean any covered wagon, and later a towed holiday home.
items.cn: 英语 caravan 先泛指带篷车，后来指拖挂的假日房车。

items.en: Van is the clipped form, first of caravan, then a word for a covered goods vehicle.
items.cn: van 是其截短形式，先指 caravan，后指有篷的运货车辆。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the caravan family the word was clipped from, and the near-meaning group places it by size and shape among other vehicles.
note.cn: 形近组收集 van 所从截出的 caravan 词族，近义组按大小与形状把它放在其他车辆之间。

entries.definition: a covered wagon or a towed holiday home
as much as a van can carry
a large goods vehicle in British English
a large goods vehicle in American English
a four-wheeled goods cart or rail car
a small bus for around a dozen people

normalIntro.en: Four letters for a box on wheels with a roof: something goes inside and moves.
normalIntro.cn: 四个字母，指一只装了轮子、盖了顶的箱子：东西装进去就运走。

normal.en: A removal van moves furniture, a delivery van brings parcels.
normal.cn: removal van 搬家具，delivery van 送包裹。

normal.en: The British luggage van means a railway carriage, not a road vehicle.
normal.cn: 英式的 luggage van 指铁路车厢，不是公路车辆。

normal.en: Van is short for caravan in British holiday talk.
normal.cn: 英式度假语境里 van 是 caravan 的简称。

normal.en: The plural is simply vans.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s。

normal.en: Caravan keeps the full older shape of the word.
normal.cn: caravan 保留了较早的全形。

abstract.en: Picture back doors open and cardboard boxes piled inside.
abstract.cn: 想象后门打开，里面堆着纸箱。

abstract.en: Hear a van idle at dawn outside a bakery.
abstract.cn: 听黎明时面包店外一辆货车空转。

abstract.en: See children climb into a school van in the rain.
abstract.cn: 看孩子们在雨里钻进校车。

examples.en: The van was too high to enter the car park.
examples.cn: 那辆货车太高，进不了停车场。

examples.en: Two men carried the sofa out to the van.
examples.cn: 两个人把沙发抬到了货车上。

examples.en: The guard's van is at the back of the train.
examples.cn: 列车员的行李车厢在列车尾部。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「弯」——大车拐弯费劲，厢式车的「弯」也是它起名的一声。

root: van 为 caravan（大篷车）的截短形式，caravan 出自中世纪拉丁语 caravana，溯源为波斯语 karwan（结队的旅人）

sensesIntro.en: A covered wagon becomes a goods vehicle, then a people carrier, then a railway luggage car, and in Britain a shortened caravan.
sensesIntro.cn: 带篷车先成为运货车辆，再成为载人车辆，再成为铁路行李车厢，在英国还成了 caravan 的简称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white van with its back doors open.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆白色厢式车后门敞开。

branches.en: The delivery branch: parcels in and out all day.
branches.cn: 配送分支：整天进进出出卖包裹。

branches.en: The passenger branch: a small group seated inside.
branches.cn: 乘客分支：车里坐着一小群人。

branches.en: The railway branch: cases ride in their own coach.
branches.cn: 铁路分支：箱子坐自己的车厢。

branches.en: The holiday branch: a towed caravan shortened.
branches.cn: 度假分支：拖挂房车的简称。

branches.en: The shape branch: a roof and closed sides define the van.
branches.cn: 形状分支：有顶有侧壁才是厢式车。

intro.en: A clipped word: caravan lost its head and kept its tail.
intro.cn: 一个截短词：caravan 丢掉了头，留下了尾。

latinIntro.en: The full form caravan came from Persian karwan through Latin and French; the four-letter van contains no separable Latin piece.
latinIntro.cn: 全形 caravan 经拉丁语与法语来自波斯语 karwan；四字母的 van 里已没有可拆的拉丁成分。

items.example: Van is complete on its own today.
Caravan survives beside the short form.

definition_zh: 变化；变动；差异；变体、变奏；变异
definition_en: a change in amount, level or form, or a different version of something
core_image: 同一首歌被唱了五遍，每一遍的音高都略有不同
scene: 气象站的记录本上，同一个月的降雨量每年都不一样。There is a wide variation in temperature between day and night in the desert.
sceneCN: 这里 variation 是「差异、变化幅度」（第 2 个义项：程度上的不同）；句意为沙漠里昼夜温差很大。同一首歌每遍音高略异，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 名词：变化、变动、差异；变体、变奏；变异

collocations.zh: 主题变奏、略加改动的版本

derivatives.zh: 动词，义为「变化、不同」，是本词的动词形式
名词或形容词，义为「变体、变种」
形容词，义为「多样的、各不相同的」
名词，义为「可变性、波动幅度」
形容词或名词，义为「可变的、变量」

senses.title: The act of changing
senses.titleCN: 变化：某物在改变的过程
senses.definition: the act or process of changing
senses.definitionCN: 正在改变的动作或过程
senses.example: Careful measurement showed a slight variation in pressure overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 仔细测量显示夜间气压有细微变化。
senses.why: Latin variare means to change, and -atio names the act; the word is the process itself.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 variare 意为改变，-atio 命名这一行为；这个词就是过程本身。

senses.title: A difference in amount
senses.definition: a difference in amount, level or degree between things
senses.definitionCN: 事物之间在数量、水平或程度上的不同
senses.example: There is a wide variation in temperature between day and night in the desert.
senses.exampleCN: 沙漠里昼夜温差很大。
senses.why: Once difference is measured, the word shifts from process to size: the amount of difference.
senses.whyCN: 差异一旦被测量，这个词就从过程变成幅度：差了多少。

senses.title: A changed version
senses.definition: a thing that differs slightly from another of the same kind
senses.definitionCN: 与同类事物略有不同的版本
senses.example: The chef offered a vegetarian variation of the same dish.
senses.exampleCN: 厨师给同一道菜提供了素食版本。
senses.why: The same base appears in a new shape; the family resemblance stays visible.
senses.whyCN: 同一个底子换了一个形状出现，家族的相似仍然看得见。

senses.title: A musical form
senses.titleCN: 变奏：把一个主题反复改写
senses.definition: a repeated melody altered in rhythm, key or harmony
senses.definitionCN: 把一段旋律在节奏、调性或和声上反复改写
senses.example: The pianist played a set of variations on a folk tune.
senses.exampleCN: 钢琴家演奏了一组民谣主题变奏。
senses.why: Music makes the idea audible: one theme, many dresses.
senses.whyCN: 音乐让这个概念可以被听见：同一个主题，换很多件衣服。

senses.title: Biological difference
senses.titleCN: 变异：同种生物个体间的差别
senses.definition: differences between individuals of the same species, often inherited
senses.definitionCN: 同种生物个体之间的差别，常由遗传造成
senses.example: Genetic variation is what allows a population to adapt.
senses.exampleCN: 遗传变异使得一个种群能够适应环境。
senses.why: Living things copy themselves imperfectly, so each generation carries small differences that selection can use.
senses.whyCN: 生物复制自身时并不完美，于是每一代都带着细微差别，供自然选择使用。

intro.en: Variation is the Latin verb variare plus the noun ending -atio, a way of naming a process.
intro.cn: variation 是拉丁动词 variare 加名词词尾 -atio，用来给一个过程命名。

items.en: The verb variare meant to make different or to shift between forms.
items.cn: 动词 variare 意为使不同，或在各形式之间变换。

items.en: The noun variatio named the act of changing, with the ending -atio for an action.
items.cn: 名词 variatio 指改变的行为，词尾 -atio 表示动作。

items.en: Old French passed on variacion, still meaning a change or difference.
items.cn: 古法语传下 variacion，仍指变化或差异。

items.en: English took variation in the fourteenth century for changes in weather, price and form.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 variation，用于天气、价格与形式的变化。

items.en: Modern usage adds music and biology, giving the word a technical life beside its everyday one.
items.cn: 现代用法增添了音乐与生物学，使这个词在日常生活之外又有了术语的生命。

note.en: The look-alike group is the vari- family; the near-meaning group gathers words for difference and change.
note.cn: 形近组是 vari- 家族；近义组收表示差异与变化的词。

entries.definition: The verb, to differ or change by degrees.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「变化、不同」，是它的动词形式。

entries.definition: A form that differs from the standard one.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「变体」，与标准形式不同。

entries.definition: A range of kinds, rather than one change.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「多样性、种类」，不是单次变化。

entries.definition: Something that is able to change.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或名词，义为「可变的、变量」。

entries.definition: The plain noun for becoming different.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「变化」，最普通的说法。

entries.definition: Rising and falling again and again, like a level.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「波动」，反复起落。

entries.definition: The gap between two things, without motion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「差别」，不含运动感。

entries.definition: One form of something that exists in several forms.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「版本」，几个形式中的一个。

normalIntro.en: The hooks lean on the vari- family and on phrases like variation on a theme.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子依靠 vari- 词族与 variation on a theme 这类搭配。

normal.en: Vary is the verb, variation is the change itself.
normal.cn: vary 是动词，variation 是变化本身。

normal.en: A variation on a theme is the same tune in new clothes.
normal.cn: variation on a theme 就是同一段旋律换了衣服。

normal.en: Genetic variation is why siblings are not identical.
normal.cn: 遗传变异是兄弟姐妹不完全相同的原因。

normal.en: Seasonal variation explains why prices move with the calendar.
normal.cn: 季节变化解释了价格为何跟着日历走。

normal.en: A wide variation means the numbers are far apart.
normal.cn: wide variation 指数字彼此差距很大。

abstract.en: Variation is difference with a memory: it tells you what the same thing looks like elsewhere.
abstract.cn: 变化是一种带记忆的差别：它告诉你同一事物在别处长什么样。

abstract.en: One process, several versions, many notes: the word carries all three without changing shape.
abstract.cn: 一个过程、几个版本、许多音符：这个词不变形就能承载三者。

abstract.en: Without variation there is no selection; difference is what time can work on.
abstract.cn: 没有差异就没有选择；时间能作用的正是差别。

examples.en: There is a wide variation in rainfall across the region.
examples.cn: 这个地区的降雨量差异很大。

examples.en: The design is a variation on a chair she made last year.
examples.cn: 这个设计是她去年做的一把椅子的变体。

examples.en: Small variations in temperature can change the result.
examples.cn: 温度的细微变化就可能改变结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威瑞一起」——威（风）瑞（雨）一起变，变化就来了：变化

root: 源自拉丁语动词 variare「改变」的名词形式 variatio，经古法语进入英语；同族词有 vary、variant、variety、variable。

sensesIntro.en: Variation covers a process, a measured gap, a new version, a piece of music and a fact of biology.
sensesIntro.cn: variation 涵盖一个过程、一个测得的差距、一个新版本、一段音乐和一条生物学事实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same tune sung five times, each time a little different.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一首歌被唱了五遍，每遍都略有不同。

branches.en: PROCESS LINE: change happening over time.
branches.cn: 过程线：随时间发生的变化。

branches.en: SIZE LINE: how far the values sit apart.
branches.cn: 幅度线：数值之间差多少。

branches.en: FORM LINE: the same thing in a new dress.
branches.cn: 形式线：同一样东西换的新装。

branches.en: LIFE LINE: inherited differences in a species.
branches.cn: 生命线：种群中可遗传的差别。

branches.en: CONTRAST: variation is measured, difference is simply noticed.
branches.cn: 对照线：variation 要被测量，difference 只需被察觉。

intro.en: Variation is a root plus an action-noun ending; the whole vari- family shares that stem.
intro.cn: variation 是词根加表动作的名词词尾，整个 vari- 家族共用这个词干。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are variare, to change, and -atio, the action noun ending.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁构件是 variare「改变」和表示动作名词的 -atio。

items.example: It shows the word in use.

definition_zh: 多样性、变化；种类、品种；（同一类的）若干不同事物；综艺节目
definition_en: a range of different kinds of the same thing, or one particular kind
core_image: 一个装满各色水果的篮子，每一样都不同，却都属于水果
scene: 菜市场的摊位上摆着十几种番茄，大小颜色各不相同。The shop sells a wide variety of teas from the mountains.
sceneCN: 这里 variety 是「种类」（第 2 个义项：某一类中的一种）；句意为这家店出售山上产的各种茶叶。满篮各色果实互不相同的样子，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 名词：多样性、变化；种类、品种；综艺节目

derivatives.zh: 形容词，义为「各种各样的」，是本词的形容词形式
动词，义为「变化、不同」
形容词，义为「多样的、各不相同的」
名词，义为「变体、变种」
形容词或名词，义为「可变的、变量」

senses.title: A range of kinds
senses.titleCN: 多样性：许多不同种类的集合
senses.definition: many different kinds of the same general thing
senses.definitionCN: 同一大类下许多不同的种类
senses.example: The market offers a wide variety of fruit in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天市场上水果种类很多。
senses.why: Latin varius means spotted or mixed; variety is the pattern of many kinds together.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 varius 意为斑驳的、混杂的；variety 就是多种东西并置的图案。

senses.title: One kind among many
senses.titleCN: 种类：其中的某一个品种
senses.definition: a particular kind within a larger group, often a plant or product
senses.definitionCN: 较大类别中的某一具体种类，常指植物或产品
senses.example: The shop sells a wide variety of teas from the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店出售山上产的各种茶叶。
senses.why: The collective word narrows to a single item: this variety here, not the whole set.
senses.whyCN: 这个集合名词收窄为单个个体：是这一个品种，不是全部。

senses.title: Lack of sameness
senses.definition: the quality of not being all the same, valued as interest
senses.definitionCN: 不一模一样的性质，被视为有趣可贵
senses.example: A little variety in the menu keeps the children interested.
senses.exampleCN: 菜单上有点变化能让孩子们保持兴趣。
senses.why: Here the word judges rather than lists: sameness is dull, variety is good.
senses.whyCN: 这里的这个词在做评价而不是在列举：单调乏味，多样才好。

senses.title: A music hall show
senses.titleCN: 综艺：由多种节目拼成的演出
senses.definition: a show of separate acts such as singing, dance and comedy
senses.definitionCN: 由歌唱、舞蹈、滑稽戏等独立节目拼成的演出
senses.example: The theatre still puts on a variety show every winter.
senses.exampleCN: 这家剧院每到冬天仍上演综艺节目。
senses.why: A show of many acts is variety made visible: one stage, many kinds.
senses.whyCN: 多种节目同台就是可见的多样性：一个舞台，许多门类。

senses.title: A biological subspecies
senses.titleCN: 生物变种：人工培育或自然分化的品种
senses.definition: a group of plants or animals differing slightly from the species, such as a cultivated breed
senses.definitionCN: 与物种略有差异的动植物群体，如栽培品种
senses.example: This variety of apple ripens earlier than the others.
senses.exampleCN: 这个苹果品种比其他的成熟得早。
senses.why: Growers keep a stable set of traits and give it a name, and that named set is the variety.
senses.whyCN: 栽培者把一组稳定性状固定下来并给它命名，这个被命名的群体就是品种。

intro.en: Variety comes from Latin varietas through French, built on varius, meaning spotted or of many colours.
intro.cn: variety 经由法语来自拉丁语 varietas，词根 varius 意为斑驳的、多色的。

items.en: The adjective varius described skins, stones or animals marked with several colours.
items.cn: 形容词 varius 描述带多色斑纹的皮、石头或动物。

items.en: The noun varietas named diversity and difference, with the ending -tas for a state.
items.cn: 名词 varietas 指多样与差异，词尾 -tas 表示状态。

items.en: French carried variété into everyday use for the many kinds of a thing.
items.cn: 法语把 variété 带入日常使用，表示同一事物的许多种类。

items.en: English borrowed variety in the sixteenth century, first for diversity, then for a kind.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 variety，先表多样性，后表某一品种。

items.en: In the nineteenth century variety halls gave the word its show business sense.
items.cn: 十九世纪的杂耍剧院给了这个词演艺行业的含义。

note.en: The look-alike group is the vari- family; the near-meaning group holds words for range and for a single kind.
note.cn: 形近组是 vari- 家族；近义组收表示范围与单一品种的词。

entries.definition: Of several kinds; the adjective of the same stem.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「各种各样的」，同词干的形容词。

entries.definition: The verb, to differ or change.
A change or a changed version.
Something that changes; the technical cousin.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或名词，义为「可变的、变量」，技术性的近亲。

entries.definition: Difference among things, often used of people and species.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「多样性」，常用于人群与物种。

entries.definition: The spread from one end to the other of a set.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「范围」，一套东西从头到尾的跨度。

entries.definition: A group of different things to choose from.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「可供挑选的一组」，强调可挑选。

entries.definition: One kind of animal kept by people, closer to a single variety.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「品种」，更接近单个品种。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the basket-of-fruit core and phrases like a wide variety of.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用「一篮果子」的意象与 a wide variety of 这类搭配。

normal.en: A variety of teas means many different teas, not one.
normal.cn: a variety of teas 指许多不同的茶，不是一种。

normal.en: Variety is the opposite of sameness in food, music and life.
normal.cn: variety 在食物、音乐和生活中都是「单调」的反面。

normal.en: A new variety of rice may ripen earlier than the old one.
normal.cn: 一个新稻种可能比旧的成熟得早。

normal.en: A variety show strings separate acts onto one stage.
normal.cn: variety show 把各种独立节目串在一个舞台上。

normal.en: Add variety to a routine and the routine stops feeling like a routine.
normal.cn: 给日常加点变化，日常就不再像日常。

abstract.en: The word holds both the whole and one piece of it: a variety of things, and the variety you picked.
abstract.cn: 这个词同时装下整体与一片：诸多种类，以及你选中的那一种。

abstract.en: Diversity is a pattern, not a list: it needs to be seen from above.
abstract.cn: 多样性是一种图案而非清单：它需要从上方看才成形。

abstract.en: Sameness repeats, variety remembers: a varied diet and a varied life both stay alive longer.
abstract.cn: 单调只是重复，多样带着记忆：多样的饮食与多样的生活都活得更久。

examples.en: The library offers a variety of books for young readers.
examples.cn: 这家图书馆为小读者提供各种图书。

examples.en: We stayed at home for a variety of reasons.
examples.cn: 我们待在家里，原因有好几种。

examples.en: This variety of tomato grows well in cool weather.
examples.cn: 这个番茄品种在凉爽天气里长得很好。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我瑞爱提」——我瑞（锐）意爱提各种花样：多样性

root: 源自拉丁语名词 varietas（词根 varius「斑驳的、多样的」），经法语 variété 于十六世纪进入英语；同族词有 various、vary、variation、variable。

sensesIntro.en: Variety can mean many kinds together, one kind by itself, the pleasure of change, a stage show or a plant breed.
sensesIntro.cn: variety 可以指多种并存、单一品种、变化带来的趣味、综艺演出或植物品种。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a basket of fruit where every piece is a different kind.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只篮子，里面每个果子都是不同种类。

branches.en: SET LINE: many kinds seen together.
branches.cn: 集合线：许多种类放在一起看。

branches.en: ITEM LINE: one particular breed or kind.
branches.cn: 个体线：某一个具体品种。

branches.en: PLEASURE LINE: change that keeps things interesting.
branches.cn: 趣味线：让人保持新鲜的变化。

branches.en: STAGE LINE: many acts in one show.
branches.cn: 舞台线：一场演出里许多节目。

branches.en: CONTRAST: variety is the whole basket, a kind is one fruit.
branches.cn: 对照线：variety 是整篮，a kind 是一个果子。

intro.en: Variety is a Latin state noun; its family supplies the adjective, verb and technical forms.
intro.cn: variety 是拉丁语状态名词，它的家族还提供形容词、动词与技术形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are varius, varietas and the adjective varius giving various.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁构件是 varius、varietas，而 various 直接来自 varius。
